title: 航空基礎数学
subtitle: Basic Mathematics for Aeronautics
keywords: Differential and integral calculus 2.Differential equations 3.Equations of motion 4.Falling motions 5.Vibration motions
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn basic mathematics knowledge necessary for studying major subjects in Department of Aeronautics. In addition, students will use their knowledge of mathematics to deal with the dynamics of mass points, and acquire the basic skills for examining various engineering problems using mathematics.
advice: In this course, students will learn the basic mathematics knowledge necessary for studying major subjects in Department of Aeronautics. Contents are as follows: 1 Differential and integral calculus 2 Differential equations 3 Equations of motion 4 Falling motions Free-fall motion Falling motion with drag which is proportional to the falling velocity 5 Vibration motions Response to initial excitation without damping
books: No specific textbook is specified. Lectures will be conducted according to handouts.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge on differential/integral calculus and trigometric functions at the high school graduation level.

activityGoals.body: Be able to find derivatives of basic functions
Be able to find indefinite integrals of basic functions
Be able to solve first-order linear differential equations
Be able to solve second-order linear differential equations
Be able to derive the equation of motion for the response to initial excitation without damping
